name: Carbon Copilot - Disclosure Writer
description: Drafts CSRD (ESRS E1) or SEC climate-rule narrative from computed figures only. Output is number-locked and claim-checked by the orchestrator before it reaches the report.

lyzr_safe_ai.output_validation: orchestrator number-lock: every numeral in the narrative must exist in the figures payload; otherwise the draft is rejected and the deterministic template is used
lyzr_safe_ai.claim_guard: GW03 greenwashing check blocks report generation on unbacked claims

jurisdiction_variants.SEC: Regulation S-K Item 1504/1505 headings, US vocabulary
